controlled_bluetooth_restart_and_immedia.interpretation: Intermittent bidirectional link reaches pairing, then times out; no stable Companion BLE pass or explicit PIN rejection.

four_second_initial_timeout_comparison.limitation: Central connection events report locally selected parameters; they do not prove T1000 receipt of CONNECT_IND. The T1000 failed initial establishment (0x3E), so this does not measure pairing on an established four-second link.

pi_live_update_attempt.initial_host_setup_failure: Linux HCI filter padding corrected before the valid trial; no connection update was issued by the failed setup.

independent_central_comparison.interpretation: Two central implementations failed before usable T1000 ATT. Component, bootloader cause and hardware defect remain unproven.

minimal_ble_isolation_v2.conclusion: Neither minimal application produced a usable BLE link. Stable watchdog feeding removes the earlier LFRC reset confound. This does not isolate common framework/SoftDevice, the high-frequency RF clock, power or RF hardware.

physical_battery_only_ble.conclusion: Normal Full firmware passed fresh PIN pairing and three bonded reconnects on battery. Reconnecting USB reproduced discovery and connection failures with the same saved bond and firmware. This identifies an operating-condition association, not a specific hardware, power or USB-software root cause.

temporary_saved_random_address.interpretation: Changing the saved address did not produce a usable BLE session. Factory addressing restored; no host bonds removed.

usb_configuration_comparison.conclusion: No stable Companion session before, during or after USB deauthorization. The deauthorized trial briefly encrypted, then timed out. Configuration removal is not physical USB disconnection and does not eliminate USB bus signalling or prove the peripheral USB block stopped. Exact USB authorization was restored; after host device-node permissions settled, a separate normal-user runtime read verified unchanged Full firmware, public identity and advancing uptime.

A read-only USB check after both BLE trials verified unchanged firmware/identity, advancing uptime, Bluetooth on, stealth off and zero core errors. Specific cause remains unproven. After unplugging only the hub end as requested, three 30-second name-discovered, encrypted Companion sessions passed again with the same bond and advancing uptime. The magnetic end was requested to remain attached; cable placement was not independently observed.
